title: Act 5 Part 1 — The Financial Web: Lawyers, Bondholders, Saturn Funding Trust and Orbit
ledger: Even if Elon and Jensen solve the chip-manufacturing physics, they must survive the lawyers, the bondholders and the US government
Three gates: lawyers, bonds, government building
A financial web ties SpaceX and NVIDIA together; it is not a clean breakup where Elon can poach NVIDIA's founder and walk away
Web of cords between SpaceX and NVIDIA; Jensen pulled back

On November 20, 2026 Apollo Global Management and Goldman Sachs priced roughly $44 billion in off-balance-sheet lease notes, the largest GPU financing deal ever, to buy NVIDIA Vera Rubin GPUs and lease them to SpaceX through Saturn Funding Trust; racks land in the first half of 2027
Notes stack, Saturn Funding Trust, racks leased to SpaceX
Lenders watch SpaceX's plans to launch Star Mind GPUs into orbit in late 2027; a lender can repossess a rack in a Texas data center but cannot send a repo truck into low-Earth orbit
Repo truck takes a rack, cannot reach orbit
cues: Jensen is pulled back by the web
